data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Chere refers to cherubs, mythical winged beings. In Christianity, cherubs are depicted as celestial beings with wings, often guarding God's throne. The name Chere carries the meaning “Cherub” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Chere usually hope their child will grow to embody cherub and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chere total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Chere" carries a deep spiritual significance as it represents guardians of the divine presence and protectors of God's throne.
